property_summary: For any successful payable call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether, the reference contract always updates pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp (a time value), whereas the mutant that assigns pastBlockTime = block.number will for some fuzzed block timestamps/blocks produce pastBlockTime != block.timestamp, violating that rule.
change_summary: Assign pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp (single-statement replacement).
